entries.71efcbf8c992c4af: It states its basic philosophy as “Let’s enjoy growth,” and aims to create a setting where each individual can work with a sense of purpose while enjoying growth, and to realize a society in which everyone can work with vitality. In the HR-Related Business, it plans to expand direct services to end-client companies through call center dispatch, strengthen the use of women, senior citizens and global human resources, improve the functions of its core system and use AI for matching, and streamline clerical work through RPA.
